Upstage Accelerates IPO, Appoints 'SBVA Veteran' Yoon-jung Jin as CFO

**VC Analyst Who Invested Since Series A to Join End of This Month**

(Seoul=Yonhap Infomax) Yong Bi Yang - Upstage, South Korea's leading artificial intelligence (AI) company, has appointed a chief financial officer (CFO) to spearhead its IPO process. An analyst from investor SBVA (formerly SoftBank Ventures Asia) will take charge of the company's financial operations.

According to the investment banking (IB) industry on the 6th, Upstage recently designated Yoon-jung Jin, managing director at SBVA, as its CFO. She is scheduled to join Upstage at the end of this month to oversee finance and accounting. She is also expected to lead the listing process.

After graduating from Georgetown University in the U.S., Jin worked in the investment banking divisions of Credit Suisse in New York and Hong Kong, and at Merrill Lynch, handling IPO and merger and acquisition (M&A) transactions. She later connected with the venture ecosystem through Stanford University's MBA program and has been a venture capitalist since 2013.

Starting her career as an analyst with impact investing at D3 Jubilee Partners in 2013, she joined SBVA the following year to invest in Korean and Southeast Asian companies. Her portfolio includes Upstage, HyperAccel, Nears Lab, and Lapo Labs.

Jin has deep knowledge of Upstage, having led SBVA's investment in the company. She has served as an external running mate for Upstage by participating consecutively in the Series A round in 2021 and Series B round in 2024.

Her appointment as CFO is expected to accelerate Upstage's listing process. Having selected KB Securities and Mirae Asset Securities as lead underwriters, Upstage plans to file for preliminary listing review as early as May and debut on the stock market within this year.

Given Jin's past experience in IPO transactions and her involvement in numerous portfolio company listings, she is expected to serve as a guide throughout Upstage's IPO process.

Upstage is a company that develops generative AI models. "Solar" is its flagship service. Its technology has already gained recognition in the global market. Solar became the first Korean LLM to be selected as a frontier-grade model in global performance evaluations.

"Solar Pro 2" was named one of the top 10 frontier models alongside OpenAI and Google by AI model evaluator Artificial Analysis. Elon Musk shared these results on social media, drawing significant attention. Following continued acclaim, the company was selected as a national champion AI company by the government last year.

The company has benefited from venture capital during its growth phase. From 2021 to this year, it has raised approximately 250 billion won ($210 million) in investment, emerging as a frontrunner among domestic AI companies. The valuation being discussed during this year's IPO process is around 2 trillion won ($1.7 billion).
